# om-emu additions (patch set)

Eleven patches for the om-emu emulator that add screen layers and pre-flash crash checks.

[Contribution home](https://github.com/nsud-dev/olympus-firmware-notes/issues). Plain patch files for a fixed om-emu commit. Offered here until om-emu takes them upstream. Tested on E-M5 III 1.7, and briefly on OM-5 1.2 and OM-5 II 1.1 block 0.
